issue.title: Task types: Pomodoro themes become per-task types that always agree with their Task Links
issue.description: Every open task has one computed task type (field, reading rule, note default, then plan.default_type, CHORE for Bryan). Every live Task Link agrees with its task's type: type edits move links, link moves and named captures retype tasks, and Bob places new links by type. Explicit types render as a colored #TYPE in place of the #task glyph. The words "theme" and "Pomodoro theme" become "task type" everywhere a person reads them.
